cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Confirm: 401, 403 forbidden, 400 bad_url or bad_answers, 409 already_onboarded; an added brand also 402 no_credits or trial_over
Build: 403 unconfirmed, 503 paused, 402 (trial, Noor's cap, credits), 429 after 3 tries in 24 h, 409 busy
402 raises the limit dialog; 429 says today's setup limit (manual form still works); any 409 says 'Setup is still running'; others 'Could not set up the workspace'
Once a brand exists, confirm and /api/onboard both answer 409 already_onboarded
Banned words: approve and publish refuse a breaking draft in code (409 brand_violation)

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are paused since 2026-09-28 (CLAUDE_PAUSED)
/api/onboard answers 503 paused before the payment check, the tries, the lock and the crawl: nothing is charged
The owner sees 'Workspace setup is paused for now and nothing was saved'
buildFromSite never falls back to the mock
The manual brand form and the Dictionary's 'I don't have a website' path still save a brand without the model

cards.title: Added brand setup: 9 credits
items: The first brand (the default scope) is free; each added brand costs 9 credits to set up from its URL
Step 7 states the cost and the balance; Go is off under 9 credits unless the setup is already paid for
Charged to Noor under her monthly cap, under the run's lock, before the stream starts (80% cap warning on a fresh charge)
Held on the account (onboardPaid): a retry reuses the hold and never pays twice
Refunded when the brand file was not saved; kept once it was
The daily cron refunds a hold nobody used for a day, or only drops it when the brand exists
The manual form and the no-website path are free

cards.title: The Dictionary game
items: Seven steps in the browser only: name, sector, five words, sample plan, sample draft, Approve, analysis
Nothing is sent, saved or charged until step 7; reload loses the answers
The finished answers go with the link and are checked in code (bad_answers if not a finished game)
On a site build the owner's name, sector and tone override the model's

cards.title: Who can do this
items: Admin or owner: play the Dictionary, confirm the site, run the build and save the brand
Plain member: waiting note on /start and a read-only brand form
The cost comes from the session's active brand, never from the request
